{{Quote|We're only a few hundred meters from my quarters. Let’s talk there.|Voort saBinring to Face Loran|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Voort saBinring's apartment''' was located on the second floor of a four story greenstone building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ayceezee]]. The apartment was spacious enough to contain an office, kitchen, social room and sleeping quarters. saBinring opted for simplicity in terms of design, making the features pragmatic.<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Wraith Squadron]] leader [[Garik Loran]] visited [[Voort saBinring]] as he was heading home from work. saBinring invited Loran into his apartment to discuss Loran's proposal of rejoining the Wraiths.<ref name="MK" />
